root_cause: The language selector depended on runtime DOM discovery. The canonical V18 mobile drawer is generated during the build and its runtime structure differed across shell generations, so selector-based mounting remained brittle and production screenshots repeatedly showed no NL/EN control.
prevention: Critical global navigation controls must be projected into the canonical built HTML, not depend solely on runtime selector discovery.
The i18n build injector must place the mobile language selector directly inside aside.v18-mobile-drawer before the login action when present.
Runtime mounting remains an idempotent compatibility fallback, not the primary visibility mechanism.
Production acceptance requires a visible mobile menu control in the built artifact and working delegated language interaction.
evidence: production screenshot 2026-09-21 14:46 showing the mobile drawer without NL/EN after runtime-only recovery
